scripts.deploy:backend: bash -c 'source scripts/project-env.sh && cdk deploy "$SLUG-backend" -c app:activeColor=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "$SSM_PREFIX/active-color" --query Parameter.Value --output text)'
scripts.deploy:frontend: bash -c 'source scripts/project-env.sh && cdk deploy "$SLUG-frontend" -c app:activeColor=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "$SSM_PREFIX/active-color" --query Parameter.Value --output text)'
